comment: Single source of truth for main's branch protection (pull_request) and publish.yml's release gate (release). scripts/release_gate.py validate (CI job 'Required-check names exist') proves each name is produced by exactly one unfiltered, unskippable job in the workflow 'producers' binds it to, that 'release' keeps the gate's mandatory floor, and that publish.yml is fail-closed; the gate re-runs that validation on the tagged commit and requires the latest run of every 'release' check on that exact commit to have succeeded, reported by GitHub Actions from its bound workflow. Not required: 'pyproject / tag / PyPI agree' at release (it runs in PR mode there; the gate checks the version itself and publish.yml's verify-registry runs --mode release after upload), 'Test @v1 Action (external consumer path)' (exercises the already-published @v1, not this commit), 'Fixture change audit' (reads the PR body), 'scan' (same-repository PR comment only), lychee (external links).
pull_request: Built wheel installs and scans a directory
Default mode is never slower than serial
release: Built wheel installs and scans a directory
Default mode is never slower than serial
